study type: Observational cohort study with repeated measures
cohort: The study included 26,445 women with a median age of 25 years (IQR: 22-27) at a health service provider institution in Medellin, Colombia.
finding: The adherence rate to conventional cytology was 20.4%, and factors such as high school education, history of pregnancy, and history of STIs decreased adherence, while HPV vaccination increased it.
